title: Unified per-display Settings
brief: One Settings window for SmartWindow where every bar and notch setting can be customized per display. A single scope selector (Default or a specific display) decides what the shown settings apply to; no setting appears twice. With one display, only Default exists.

artboards.title: Scope toolbar
artboards.tradeoff: Closest to today's sidebar and to System Settings; the scope lives in the toolbar, so it is easy to miss which display you are editing on long pages

artboards.title: Display map
artboards.tradeoff: The monitor arrangement and a live bar/notch preview make the scope unmistakable; costs vertical space before the first setting

artboards.title: Displays in the sidebar
artboards.tradeoff: Each display is its own sidebar page with all its bar, widget and notch settings together; most explicit, but the sidebar grows with every monitor and app-wide panes move to a second group
